name: Manifest Anything
summary:
Manifest Anything is a playable sandbox game where players create, explore, and play fully interactive games within the experience itself. Players control a character inside generated 3D environments, navigate worlds, test mechanics, and immediately play the games they build in real time.

Using an in-game project creator and an AI companion, players generate interactive worlds, gameplay systems, and scenarios directly inside the game. Creation and play are tightly connected: players can explore environments, trigger mechanics, and iterate on their ideas by playing them instantly rather than exporting to an external editor.

Gameplay includes designing core game systems such as menus, objectives, user interfaces, and win or loss conditions. Players define gameplay rules and outcomes, then playtest those systems inside the same session. Each project functions as a complete, playable game experience rather than a static builder.

The current version includes a project creator, playable demo environments, and AI-assisted systems for assembling maps, assets, gameplay mechanics, and basic progression. As development continues, additional environments, assets, driving mechanics, and gameplay systems are planned to expand the variety and depth of games that players can create and play
